title: Itemized academic defect and evidence-gap register
scope: 18 registered ancient-language corpus repositories plus canonical master; Egyptian project excluded. Current checked-out heads frozen in revisions.
method: Adversarial desk review of repository evidence and prior executable probes, updated for the 21 October follow-up and 22 October fixed six-case source batch. No new external epigraphic review or fresh source consultation is claimed.
counting_rule: One actionable closure package per ID. Counts are work items, not independent statistical observations, corrupt readings or unique ancient objects. Source conflicts do not prove a project transcription is wrong. Related items share dependencies and evidence.

severity_rule.A: Blocks the named strong scholarly claim; not automatically a software P0 or a bar to scoped infrastructure publication.
severity_rule.B: Major limitation or bounded source repair for the named claim.

exhaustiveness_limit: No line-by-line independent collation of every reading, image, source, right or object. This register is an evidence-bound backlog, not an upper bound on defects.
